title: skills: security.md says a package position's permission sets resolve from its package and declared dependencies (ADR-0150 E3 Skills-docs follow-up)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` of child E3 #31674 of the epic #31527 (ADR-0150), named in E3's PR #31815 (report 6732978553). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: inherited from the parent #31527. An AI agent authoring a package's positions reads `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`. After #31815, a position's `permissionSets` entry resolves from the position's package: its own set, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure plus `sys`, else a refusal naming every candidate. A set that only the environment holds is refused. The skill does not say so today, so an agent can write a position that loads and then grants nothing.
Reader: the `domain:skills` seat, after PR #31815 merges.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `position permission set package closure skills` → #31735 (closed; E4's queue-recipient paragraph in the same file, not this rule) and #31674 (E3 itself), neither on point.
class: d · type: Docs
Part of #31527. Blocked-by: #31674

## 维护者速读

技能文档里写岗位引用权限集的那段，要补一句：权限集按岗位所在的软件包和它声明的依赖解析，找不到、有两个、或者只有环境里有，都会被拒绝。

## What to build

- In `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, the position or permission-set paragraph: state the resolution rule above and the three refusals (outside the closure, two holders, environment-only), with one example each. The eval that exercises position grants gains a case.
